g.text: Coin Change Permutations (Infinite Supply) — Full Recursion Tree
Coins: [2, 3, 5, 7] | Target: 10 | Every frame loops over ALL coins (0 to N-1). No starting index restriction.
After choosing 5, we can still choose 2!
In combinations this is blocked. Here, "3 5 2" is distinct from "2 3 5".
Order matters; each branch returns 1 on target == 0
